== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Primal Echoes]].
* The effects of this skill are applied before the energy modifiers from [[Quickening Zephyr]] or [[Energizing Wind]]. 
* [[Expertise]] will reduce the increased cost of ranger signets. 
* This skill often ruins [[bonder]]s who use [[Blessed Signet]] for energy management.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
